msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia tribeca-boutique-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing an olive green velvet jacket hand-embroidered with colourful flowers, worn open over a long flowing dress from the reference, walking at the Plaza de los Naranjos in the old town of Marbella, Spain, with whitewashed houses, orange trees and flower pots, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia tribeca-boutique-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an orange velvet jacket hand-embroidered with green, cream and red folk motifs and a long beaded necklace from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia tribeca-boutique-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a crochet ethnic waistcoat with coloured woven bands, beads and long cream fringes, over a white T-shirt and light jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia tribeca-boutique-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pale blue faux-fur coat with a brown faux-fur collar and cuffs and a tie belt, with flared jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia tribeca-boutique-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pair of handmade soutache statement earrings in ivory and pink with a pale pink crystal, no logos from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
